title: 第 2160 章 老一辈的执念无尽之海第 2159 章 又十年太反常太诡异
slug: 儒道至上我在异界背唐诗
content_zh:
似是精准看穿了词宋心底沉沉的警惕与隐忧，身侧轻晃摇椅的仲寐，眸光恬淡依旧，缓缓开口出声，冲淡了些许凝滞凝重的氛围。
“无需过度忧心。
浩劫诡变，未来藏谜，你我纵然算不透，却也守得住当下。”
他语气平和笃定，带着历经世事的通透沉稳，字字从容道来：“兵来将挡，水来土掩。
如今诸天百家唯一的执念与使命，便是守住天元界域，护好这一方苍生山河，任凭域外风云诡谲、棋局暗换，我自岿然不动，以守待变。”
词宋闻言微微侧目，紧绷的眉心稍稍舒展，静静聆听着他接下来的述说。
“这些年天元灵气复苏，大道渐醒，天地道韵愈发圆满，桎梏万古的寿元枷锁与境界壁垒层层松动。”
仲寐话锋一转，道出这两年的变局，“此前天外天蛰伏两千年、熬尽岁月桎梏的一众老亚圣，尽数借天地大势破境成圣，登临圣人之位。”
“这批老一辈圣人，底蕴深厚、阅历万古，与白夜、端木擎苍等新晋现世的新生代圣人截然不同。
他们半生蛰伏天外天，阅览过上古仙道残存的碎片秘辛，对仙界极为向往。”
谈及此处，仲寐眼底掠过一抹淡淡深意：“故而他们踏破界障、立身虚空，亲眼见过浩瀚宇宙的辽阔苍茫之后，心底便生出了远赴仙界、求索终极大道的执念。”
超脱凡俗圣境，奔赴无上仙界，这是每一位上古修行者深埋心底的终极夙愿，是挣脱天地桎梏、问鼎大道尽头的唯一出路。
“不过他们并未贸然冲动行事。”
仲寐缓缓续道，“仙界隐匿于浩瀚虚空深处，时序错乱、壁垒重重，无方位可寻、无轨迹可溯，贸然探寻只会迷失混沌、身死道消。”
“为探明仙界踪迹、锁定虚空仙域坐标，这两年一众圣人一直在暗中奔走，主动接触天外天的仙人。”
“只待浩劫安稳、局势明朗之日，便可踏破混沌、登临仙界，完成自己毕生夙愿。”
娓娓话语落定，将这两年诸天高层悄然布局的隐秘尽数道尽。
词宋静静听闻，心底豁然通透，也彻底摸清了如今诸天的整体布局。
词宋心中彻底了然全局，心境愈发平和通透。
如今天元内陆再无动荡隐患，仙脉逐步解封、地脉复苏滋养，灵气愈发鼎盛，天地法理日渐圆满，万物生灵皆在稳步复苏，整片大陆的局势已然彻底向好，彻底走出了过往浩劫笼罩的阴霾。

他也全然理解那些老一辈远赴仙界的执念，世人皆道他们是贪求更高大道、无上境界，可词宋深知，这群蛰伏万古、熬破寿元桎梏的老者，所求从来不止修行精进。
他们生于文道鼎盛的时代，亲眼见证过诸子百家争鸣的璀璨风华，亲历过诸圣临世、传道济世的辉煌过往，也曾目送一代代圣贤破开虚空、飞升仙界，将文道火种带往诸天之上。
他们心底早已埋下执念，穷尽万古修行，只为追随着先贤的脚步，踏上那片诸圣扎根的仙界故土。
哪怕隐约知晓如今仙界残破衰败、不复上古盛景，哪怕前路混沌未知、危机暗藏，他们依旧初心不改。
content_en:
As if he had accurately seen through the deep vigilance and hidden worries in Ci Song's heart, Zhong Mei, who was rocking the rocking chair beside him, his eyes still calm, slowly spoke out, diluting the somewhat stagnant and solemn atmosphere.
“No need to worry too much.
The catastrophe is changing, and the future is full of mysteries. Even if you and I can't figure it out, we can still hold on to the present. "
His tone was calm and determined, with the clarity and calmness of having experienced the world, and he spoke calmly every word: "When soldiers come, they will block it, and when water comes, the earth will cover it up.
Nowadays, the only obsession and mission of all the heavens and hundreds of families is to guard the Tianyuan realm and protect the mountains and rivers of this area. No matter how strange the situation outside the realm is and the chess game changes secretly, I will remain unmoved and wait for the changes. "
Ci Song glanced slightly sideways when he heard the words, his tense eyebrows relaxed slightly, and he listened quietly to what he was going to say next.
"Over the years, the spiritual energy of Tianyuan has revived, the great path has gradually awakened, the charm of heaven and earth has become more and more complete, and the shackles of longevity and realm barriers that have restricted the eternity have been loosened layer by layer."
Zhong Mei changed the topic and spoke of the changes in the past two years, "Previously, all the old sub-sages who had been dormant for two thousand years and endured the shackles of the years, all took advantage of the general trend of heaven and earth to break through and become saints, ascending to the position of saints."
"This group of older generation saints have profound foundations and eternal experience, and are completely different from the new generation saints such as Bai Ye and Duanmu Qingcang.
They have been dormant in the outer world for half their lives, have read the remaining fragments and secrets of the ancient immortal way, and are extremely yearning for the immortal world. "
Speaking of this, a hint of deep meaning flashed across Zhong Mei's eyes: "So after they broke through the barriers, stood in the void, and saw the vastness of the vast universe with their own eyes, they developed the obsession to go to the fairy world and seek the ultimate road."
To transcend the mundane holy realm and go to the supreme fairyland is the ultimate long-cherished wish of every ancient practitioner. It is the only way to break free from the shackles of heaven and earth and strive for the end of the road.
"But they didn't act impulsively."
Zhong Mei continued slowly, "The fairy world is hidden deep in the vast void. The time sequence is disordered and there are many barriers. There is no direction to find and no track to trace. If you rush to explore it, you will only get lost in chaos and die."
"In order to find out the traces of the fairyland and lock the coordinates of the Void Fairyland, a group of saints have been running secretly in the past two years, taking the initiative to contact the immortals in Tianwaitian."
"As long as the catastrophe stabilizes and the situation becomes clear, then we can break through the chaos, ascend to the fairyland, and fulfill our lifelong wish."
Wei Wei finished her words and revealed all the secrets that have been quietly laid out by the top management of the Heavens over the past two years.
Ci Song listened quietly, and his heart suddenly became clear, and he also completely understood the overall layout of the heavens today.
Ci Song completely understood the overall situation in his heart, and his mood became more peaceful and transparent.
Nowadays, there are no hidden dangers of instability in the hinterland of Tianyuan. Immortal veins are gradually unblocked, earth veins are revived and nourished, spiritual energy is becoming more and more prosperous, the laws of heaven and earth are becoming more and more perfect, and all living things are steadily recovering. The situation of the entire continent has completely improved, and has completely walked out of the haze shrouded in the past catastrophes.
He also fully understood the obsession of the older generation to go to the immortal world. Everyone said that they were greedy for higher avenues and supreme realms, but Ci Song knew very well that these old people who had been dormant for eternity and had overcome the shackles of longevity, never wanted more than just practice and practice.
They were born in an era when literature and Taoism were at their peak. They witnessed with their own eyes the splendid splendor of hundreds of schools of thought contending, experienced the glorious past when saints came to the world and preached to the world. They also watched generations of sages break through the void, ascend to the fairy world, and bring the fire of literature and Taoism to the heavens.
They have long since buried their obsessions in their hearts and have spent all eternity practicing just to follow in the footsteps of the sages and set foot on the fairyland homeland where all the saints took root.
Even if they vaguely know that the fairy world is now dilapidated and decaying and no longer the grandeur of ancient times, even if the road ahead is chaotic and unknown, with hidden dangers, they still remain true to their original aspirations.
